npcs.name: Forgotten Soul
npcs.description: Whispers from the void, now revealed as dual-natured—some guide forward, others drag down. They screamed in unison during the code attempt.

npcs.name: The Mirror Self
npcs.description: A doppelganger reflection wearing The Survivor's face, grinning and holding a blade, dwelling within the Hidden Bunker

Tower of Hell grid.description: A server with a hidden secret, shrouded in thunderous dread and a bruised sky. The corridor now warps—walls breathe, floors tilt.
notableFeatures: Shifting laser beams carving the air like razors
Warping corridor with breathing walls and tilting floors

Hidden Bunker.description: A guarded area with a mystery to crack, now breached. Inside: a mirror holding a sinister reflection wearing The Survivor's face.

Awakened Fruit.description: A powerful fruit with unknown abilities, now actively surging within The Survivor like a waking beast during moments of extreme pressure
